explicit_propositions.text: Brother Mike is a professional and certified counselor at the Arizona Deliverance Center in Maricopa County.
The Arizona Deliverance Center remained open throughout the COVID crisis while other facilities closed down.
The Arizona Deliverance Center hosts live services every Thursday and Friday evenings at 7 PM.
No individuals anointed with Holy Ghost Oil at the center have contracted the virus.
According to a Gallup poll, less than 50% of respondents believe their mental health will withstand prolonged social isolation.
A Gallup poll indicated that 15% of Americans have experienced severe mental health impacts due to the pandemic.
Fifty-three percent of men surveyed felt they could endure social distancing indefinitely, compared to 43% of women.
Adults with children at home reported poorer mental resilience than adults without children.
Older adults are generally faring better during periods of social isolation.
Most deaths attributed to COVID-19 in Arizona involve older individuals with pre-existing medical conditions.

assumptions.text: Spiritual causes—specifically demonic influence—are primary drivers of serious mental illness.
Religious faith, especially among born-again Christians, provides superior protection against mental health deterioration during crises.
Government-imposed lockdowns are irrational and disproportionate responses to public health threats.
The media and political leadership exaggerated the severity of the pandemic to instill fear and control populations.
China deliberately engineered and disseminated the virus globally as an act of bioweaponry.
President Trump’s actions were insufficient to prevent the spread of the virus due to strategic deception by foreign actors.
The economic downturn caused by lockdowns is more damaging than the direct health impact of the virus.
Public trust should be placed in religious institutions rather than mainstream scientific or governmental authorities.
Mental health struggles during the pandemic are primarily rooted in spiritual or moral failure, not systemic or biological factors.
Free counseling services offered by the Arizona Deliverance Center are uniquely effective due to their spiritual framework.
